fixesOpened.title: Saves retried when you reopen the app no longer go out as if you're signed out
fixesOpened.reporter: PostHog (session_save_failed, “permission denied for table work_types”, sent as the signed-out role): 6 people in 7 days on builds 1.0.6 (39) and 1.0.7 (41), 4 of them since yesterday's review. Each one fired within a second of the app reopening after 45+ minutes in the background. I couldn't find 4 of those 6 sessions in the database afterwards, and one person's video then got stuck uploading to a post that never saved.
fixesOpened.whatItFixes: When someone saved a session and then left the app for about an hour, the save that retries as the app reopens could go out before the app had signed the person back in. The server treated it like a logged-out visitor and refused it (“permission denied for table work_types”), so the post never reached the server and its video then got stuck. Now the app waits until the person is signed in again before sending, retries once if it is still refused, and never throws away the session or its video. A normal save without leaving the app works the same as today.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: On a phone with this build: sign in, record a short session, save it (with a clip, shared with friends), then put Latent in the background right away and leave it for more than an hour. Reopen Latent: the post should still be on your profile, a friend should see it with a playable video, and PostHog should show no “permission denied for table work_types” save failure for that reopen. The agent couldn't compile it (no Mac), so it asks you to run the Mac tests and this phone check before merging.

Hi eddie,

So iv been following your account a while and was in th waitlist thing.
Tried it out for the first time today and it seemed awesome. A lot of my
friends would also love it. Great idea and cant wait for it to be available

were on camera. Not enough - and they were in an unseemly manner - which is
ok and understandable and when I notices this i simply deleted my three
hours of footage, which maybe other people wouldnt do.
so maybe you could add a feature where i could edit some of the footage or
if other people are in the frame then put a sticker over their face before
putting it up. And many people might wanna use that footage to
amke aesthetic edits of themselves locking in and if some peoples face is
visible or smth - thats not good.

and also wherever there is a camera - there is a concern of indecency where
I share a room with my sister and she walked in rather indecent. And I
almost published that and fortunately im like oh lemme see and on the
second take i could see her crossing the screen a few times with her in her
underclothes - so maybe like make a scanner thing where it could check and
if assumes ppl are indecently dressed they ask to confirm it - like in a
nice manner where theyre concerned for safety - cuz like i might just be

This is rlly nice tho

Eddie
